short: WORLD features (M06) beat the 2019 GAN on seen GRID speakers; on unseen ones PESQ ties and ESTOI is higher. The CTC text loss (M02) adds under 0.015 ESTOI; the WER is the text head's.
position: The paper [@michelsanti2020vocoder] changes two components: a CTC character head trained jointly with the acoustic decoders (M02) and WORLD vocoder features as the acoustic route (M06); both are standard. The text loss follows the multi-task idea of a 2018 ultrasound system [@toth2018multitask] (HMM states there, CTC characters here) and moves ESTOI by 0.007 to 0.013 in one run per configuration, too little to credit. The WORLD route beats the 2019 GAN on seen GRID speakers (ESTOI 0.455 against 0.329), and a later scoring of the released samples keeps that order [@kefalas2023large]; on unseen speakers PESQ ties and ESTOI is higher (0.227 against 0.198). The reported WER comes from the CTC head of a PESQ-selected model, not from the synthesized speech. Today the same speech scores 9.29% ASR WER on seen speakers against 4.07% for the best raw-waveform system, and 38.15% against 16.05% on unseen ones [@kefalas2023large].
